title: Quote and confirm a multi-line service basket
guard: Validate every owned pet/service line and approved price/policy version; care traits are capabilities unless an approved surcharge exists
effect: Compute combo once across visit count, cap at 10 percent, snapshot each line and allocate the one order fee without double counting
alternative: Any changed selection invalidates stale quote; no guessed tax or automatic extra trait fee

title: Split boarding into employee care shifts
guard: Validate confirmed customer visits, approved care plan and each service duration
effect: Split boarding shifts to at most 480 minutes; allocate integer service-net snapshots by duration/remainders while preserving customer total and combo visit count
alternative: More than sixty shifts or missing operational facts requires review; shift time is not invented attendance

title: Start, update and stop consented foreground travel sharing
guard: Validate assigned visit, sharing consent, session version, fresh coordinate accuracy and bounded time window
effect: Replace only the latest location, expose scoped ETA/map projection and expire/stop sharing; no historical travel trail retained
alternative: Stale session, invalid coordinate, unsupported state or revoked assignment is rejected; real-device tracking acceptance remains separate

title: Request and decide a salary advance
guard: Require active signed employment, approved monthly base, at most 50 percent and one approved advance/month
effect: Submit/withdraw/reject/approve under month guard; retain rejection reason and agreed payroll offset
alternative: Pending concurrent request or exhausted approved quota -> reject; no interest or fabricated statutory case

title: Prepare source-based payroll and selected payslip print
guard: Load signed terms, verified service credits and explicit attendance/KPI source decisions
effect: Prepare immutable statement snapshots, agreed deductions/advances and identity reference; print selected statement
alternative: Availability is not attendance; unresolved source/deduction remains pending rather than reduce salary

title: Record a separate payroll adjustment
guard: Require original statement reference, agreed reason/evidence and immutable source claim
effect: Record supplement or agreed reconciliation separately; claim transfer reference exactly once
alternative: Original paid statement stays unchanged; UNKNOWN transfer requires reconciliation

title: Inspect training readiness
guard: Read source joins and feature timestamps; exclude synthetic/stale/unverified labels
effect: Return verified counts, shortages and blocked reasons without exporting real rows
alternative: Readiness does not train, import, approve or assign

title: Export verified training observations
guard: Require explicit apply/private output and export secret; at least 200 observations/50 booking groups
effect: HMAC opaque identifiers; write private point-in-time JSONL and source/hash manifest
alternative: Too few valid groups or truncated source -> no export file

title: Train and bundle a draft additive model
guard: Validate verified satisfaction label, feature availability and grouped chronological split
effect: Fit five nonnegative weights; retain baseline/test MAE and produce DRAFT JSON/evidence; bundle exact hashes
alternative: Synthetic/OSRM/heuristic labels or temporal leakage -> reject; no automatic approval

title: Import draft artifact and evidence
guard: Validate exact JSON shape, DRAFT state, temporal evidence, hashes and immutable version
effect: Persist SitterRankModel plus private original artifact/evidence for later review
alternative: Same version/different bytes or evidence mismatch -> conflict

title: Approve and activate a reviewed model
guard: Operational gate: independent source/evaluation review. API verifies current ADMIN, reviewReference, review version, improved MAE and artifact/evidence integrity
effect: Transaction records review decision and activation guard; only an approved valid model is selected
alternative: A reviewReference string does not itself prove reviewer independence; importer/reviewer separation is a process gate, not a demonstrated API rejection. Stale version -> conflict

title: Retire model and use rule fallback
guard: Validate current model review version or runtime artifact gate
effect: Retire immutable model version or retain explainable 30/25/20/15/10 policy when model is unusable
alternative: No model or bad artifact never changes prices, eligibility or money

title: Check vet-escort route and appointment feasibility
guard: Require confirmed clinic, appointment, waiting budget and return scope; road route and buffered slot must cover the full plan
effect: Compare outward/return ETA, appointment and waiting against requested slot; rank only feasible candidates
alternative: Route unavailable, over review cap or infeasible appointment returns explicit review/conflict; specialized MATCH checkout still requires Staff scope review

title: Advise an operational employee invitation shortlist
guard: Start with the authoritative eligible employee IDs; validate optional model, source statistics and road insertion feasibility
effect: Reorder candidate IDs with captured decision-time features; retain unscored eligible IDs for authoritative invitation checks
alternative: Partial routing/statistics failure cannot disqualify an otherwise eligible employee or mutate money; final acceptance rechecks occupancy

title: Track and edit an owned pending application
guard: Bind application to authenticated owner/current verified legacy contact; check PENDING version
effect: Read status directly without second OTP; edit only allowed fields with idempotent optimistic update
alternative: Admin review racing owner edit -> one guarded commit; processed application is read-only

title: Issue, sign and activate an employment document
guard: Validate actual particulars, canonical gender, contract terms and document/application version
effect: DRAFT -> ISSUED -> SIGNED -> ACTIVATED; retain encrypted immutable terms/hash and activate employment atomically
alternative: Unsigned invalid legacy gender blocks issue/sign; signed history cannot be rewritten

title: Prefill and print a versioned contract
guard: Authorize private application/contract; preserve saved terms over optional suggestions
effect: Allowlist verified prefill and render the selected document revision/reference for print
alternative: Missing original identity/schedule is reported; do not guess or mass-backfill

title: Reserve and submit legacy weekly settlement
guard: Read eligible available legacy earnings and cross-week booking quota under transaction guards
effect: Reserve earning slices and weekly claims; persist submitted request plus command/event atomically
alternative: Open case/refund, missing tax/payment or conflicting reservation -> hold/conflict

title: Approve, reject or withdraw settlement
guard: Authorize actor/current request version and approved financial policy
effect: Approve immutable amount or release reservation on eligible rejection/withdrawal with audited reason
alternative: Approved onward cannot be silently withdrawn; employee wages use payroll instead

title: Record transfer and reconcile uncertain result
guard: Validate reserved request, immutable amount, independent transfer evidence and unique bank reference
effect: PAID only for confirmed matching transfer; UNKNOWN or amount mismatch stays reconciliation state
alternative: Replayed acknowledgement cannot double-pay or release/reuse bank reference

title: Apply and release a case or refund money hold
guard: Use authoritative booking/earning guard and case/refund source reference
effect: Add audited financial lock; release only after final explicit authorized conclusion
alternative: After payout create approved adjustment; never automatic clawback

title: Publish visit reminders
guard: Bound eligible due visits and deduplicate reminder event/recipient
effect: Publish one reminder through durable notification/provider ports
alternative: This job export is not proof of runtime startup or inbox acceptance

title: Dispatch invitations and expire unanswered offers
guard: Require composed enabled worker, current booking/payment/care plan and eligible employee
effect: Bound queue pass; recheck eligibility/occupancy; persist expiring invitation and next-candidate event
alternative: No eligible employee or stale visit -> Staff attention; recommendation never assigns directly

title: Reconcile payment reminders and overdue state
guard: Check due intent/current provider result before payment/overdue decision
effect: Record deduplicated reminder/reconciliation; retain unknown provider result for Staff
alternative: No automatic debt collection or expired-order revival

title: Expire unpaid or uncollected product holds
guard: Design: identify expired current-state order under stock/version guard
effect: Design: cancel once and release only its held quantities; preserve attributable refusal rule
alternative: Full deadline scheduler integration still needs verification; prepaid timeout is not customer refusal

title: Recompute approved customer tier
guard: Design requires an approved tier threshold/discount source and verified paid annual spend
effect: Design: versioned tier assessment from eligible service/product/counter receipts
alternative: No approved current tier source means no invented discount, points or fake customer rank

title: Plan a feasible sitter visit order
guard: Validate current authorized visits, registered work windows, road matrix and workload bounds
effect: Design/export: bounded route order recommendation that preserves authoritative assignments
alternative: OSRM estimate is not live traffic or a training satisfaction label

title: Flag late check-in and operational attention
guard: Evaluate current visit/time against approved policy under bounded repeated sweep
effect: Design/export: deduplicated Staff notice and Needs action escalation
alternative: Do not charge arbitrary late fees or mark an unobserved visit completed

title: Retry durable application-status email
guard: Lease a due encrypted recipient snapshot; check bounded attempts and stable provider operation identity
effect: Send configured mail; record accepted/failure and next retry without rolling back saved application
alternative: Provider acceptance is not inbox delivery; preserve record after exhausted attempts

title: Search and confirm a service-address map point
guard: Authenticate same-origin map proxy; validate search/resolve input and supported coverage
effect: Resolve provider result; explicit user pin confirmation saves private location/GeoJSON/version
alternative: Missing provider or unsupported/ambiguous point remains explicit; do not expose provider key

title: Read road ETA and bounded route matrix
guard: Validate provider, origin/points, timeout, response bounds and exact cache identity
effect: Use Vietmap or OSRM road ETA plus policy buffers; store 15-minute matrix edges
alternative: No straight-line fabricated ETA, live-traffic guarantee or label substitution

title: Upload and read private care or applicant evidence
guard: Validate session/role, media ownership/type, encoded size, pixels and quota
effect: Normalize bounded image; store private R2 reference and authorize each resource read
alternative: Wrong owner/type/invalid image or unavailable provider -> reject; no public application URL

title: Replace an avatar or product photo
guard: Validate entity ownership or Admin permission, image bounds and current media version
effect: Normalize bounded avatar/product bytes in MongoDB; update version/hash/tombstone transactionally
alternative: Profile/product snapshot history and owner guards survive replacement/removal

title: Send a public contact enquiry
guard: Validate bounded enquiry and server-configured inbox/provider; apply rate limits
effect: Submit through backend contact-delivery port; return safe accepted/unavailable result
alternative: A configured adapter does not prove inbox receipt; do not expose inbox credentials

title: Install and recover the web application shell
guard: Require supported browser/HTTPS and current manifest/service-worker asset version
effect: Cache only approved application-shell assets; retain online/offline status and request retry feedback
alternative: No offline financial command success, cached private API data or background GPS guarantee is inferred; device acceptance remains pending
